models.qualification: A naturalistically modelled seated adult female nude identified by Brijuni National Park as Leda, the Spartan queen, with a swan. The researcher actually opened the exact scan still and the park's photograph of the physical sculpture, matching the seated pose, bent leg and extended lower leg, drapery, swan wings, rock base, and weathering. The park dates the sculpture to the early20th century and says it was intended for the winter pool constructed in1913; 1913 is the pool date, not a proven sculpture completion date. Artist not identified by the park: do not invent an author.
